body: I stand frozen, my eyes fixed on the box as it drifts down the path. The ribbon twitches, its colors fading as it descends. I feel a chill run down my spine, my mind racing with worst-case scenarios. My impulse to get away grows stronger with each passing moment, and I'm reminded of the dangers that lurk in these woods.
